crossRefs.note: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely…
These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”
translations.bsb: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”
translations.kjv: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
translations.asv: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring forth those five kings unto me out of the cave.
